narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Brussels Broadsheet"**

The site reads like a two-colour broadsheet printed for the event. Condensed uppercase headlines in red sit on warm cream paper. Inset red blocks break the page into sections, while monochrome photographs reveal their original colour on activation.

The print metaphor sets the limits: red, softened near-black and dark-brown inks on cream, with tonal surfaces for depth. Photos sit on the page like clippings; other elements stay flat. The hand-drawn Brussels logo is the one human mark among the type.
keyCharacteristics: Red and warm-neutral inks on cream; no unrelated accent colour.
Condensed uppercase display type at poster scale, set tight.
Inset rounded red blocks alternate with cream sections.
Monochrome photographs reveal their original colour on activation.
Tracked uppercase pills are the shared action form.

rules.name: The Warm Ink Rule
rules.body: Red, softened near-black and dark brown on cream. Use dark brown selectively for typographic hierarchy; do not add unrelated accent colours.

rules.name: The Large Red Rule
rules.body: Headline Red is for large text and lighter-red numeral panels. Use Marker Red for body-size red text on cream.

rules.name: The Shout and Explain Rule
rules.body: Display type is uppercase Big Shoulders; explanatory copy uses sentence-case Plus Jakarta Sans.

rules.name: The Light Numeral Rule
rules.body: Sequence numbers use the 300 weight so adjacent semibold titles stay prominent.

rules.name: The Only Photos Lift Rule
rules.body: Blocks, pills, tags and text stay flat; shadows belong to photographs.

rules.name: The Clipping Tilt Rule
rules.body: Photo rotation is restrained and removed for reduced-motion preferences.

dos: Do set headings in uppercase Big Shoulders Display at .92 line height, using Headline Red on cream or Paper Cream in red blocks.
Do keep body copy Ink on cream or Paper Cream Light on red at 17px / 1.6.
Do use the shared photo-reveal treatment for public photography.
Do use the solid pill for at most one primary action per view.
donts: Don't add unrelated interface colours, gradients or decorative tints.
Don't set body-size text in Headline Red on cream.
Don't add shadows to blocks, pills or non-photo cards.
Don't replace the hand-drawn Brussels logo with typeset lettering or recolour it.
